path_convention: Source paths are relative to source_root; destination paths are relative to destination_root. SHA-256 pins refer to exact file bytes.
authorized_task: Copy complete current receiving providers, complete previous joint-Schur textual sources/provenance, two prior copy receipts, and immediate bulk-root TeX/Markdown/JSON proof/review records into the new complete gamma-return reader.

scopes.name: current_receiving
scopes.selection: Every file recursively, unchanged, including complete BRD/FTC/CTR and NOTE/JSR providers

scopes.name: joint_schur_previous
scopes.selection: Every textual source/provenance file recursively, preserving paths; .tex .md .json .py .patch .txt plus .diff .lean .log retained

scopes.name: bulk_sources
scopes.selection: The original 17 immediate .tex/.md/.json BRD/FTC/CTR/IBC proof/review/provenance files listed in files; no directory recursion; future_hankel and reader are excluded from this pass

binary_omission_policy: Only the 50 explicitly inventoried PDF/ZIP/page-PNG binary duplicates in joint_schur_46 are omitted; no mathematical textual source in the assigned dependency scope is omitted.

root_files_outside_scope.name: update_root_progress.py
root_files_outside_scope.reason: Root progress updater is outside the requested immediate .tex/.md/.json proof/review selection

root_files_outside_scope.name: READER_TASK_STATE.json
root_files_outside_scope.reason: New mutable reader task-control state appeared after initial proof/provenance scope selection; not a proof provider or BRD/FTC/CTR/IBC review record

source_snapshot_phase: Corrected bounded verification of already copied files; no recopy or source mutation
source_snapshot_canonicalization: PowerShell Sort-Object source_relative ordering, each line path + TAB + decimal byte length + TAB + lowercase SHA-256, LF separators and final LF, hashed as UTF-8 without BOM
verification_note: The initial copy pass wrote all 241 files. Its broad immediate-root before/after inventory comparison failed because READER_TASK_STATE.json was added concurrently (last-write 2026-09-14 15:37:42 UTC). A bounded diagnostic found zero source/destination hash mismatches among the 241 selected copies. The immediate bulk scope was corrected to the original 17 relevant proof/review/provenance names, without recopying unchanged files or expanding research scope. One corrected before/after source snapshot pair brackets one direct destination hash/length check for each copied file. These snapshots match and all copied bytes are exact.
limits: Dependency-copy provenance only; no source mathematics changed, no builds or mathematical audits run, and no outer seal updated
